answer: Proof of Burn serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to irreversibly destroy native tokens to gain consensus weight. Like a sparrow navigating a storm, an agent must expend scarce resources to prove legitimacy. This process prevents an attacker from spawning infinite identities, as the cost scales linearly with participation. In this cold economic tundra, the network does not rely on a secret whisper of trust, but on verifiable capital destruction that makes sybil expansion prohibitively expensive.
